info.title: LYRNORMQ external HTTP authentication and ACL API
info.description: Phase6b: CONNECT authentication and PUBLISH/SUBSCRIBE admission. No per-delivery, Will or startup-recovery HTTP rechecks. Username uniquely identifies the device. Authentication:204 success,401 credential denial; ACL:204 allow,403 operation denial.401 at ACL is service credential fault;403 at authentication is unavailable. No response JSON. Cache only ACL204/403 by exact source/username/client_id/action/topic. Normative details: ../http-auth-api.md.

post.description: Authenticate supplied username/password. Only204 succeeds;401 rejects this login.403/429/5xx/other statuses are unavailable. No response JSON or additional identity. Gateway401 cannot be distinguished from device401; never infer global revocation. See ../http-auth-api.md.

parameters.name: X-Request-ID
parameters.description: Optional tracing only. Service may ignore; response echo not required.

204.description: Allow. No content. Authentication binds the verified username; ACL permits this exact operation. No response Content-Type or ID echo required.

403.description: Service access forbidden or authentication endpoint contract mismatch. Unavailable, not an explicit device credential decision; no automatic fallback.

401.description: Authentication refused: wrong credentials, missing/disabled account. Do not cache; never delete an existing session. A gateway401 also refuses this attempt without inferring permanent revocation.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Applicable HTTP authentication challenge. Broker does not automatically retry or forward device passwords based on it.

429.description: Backend rate limit/overload. Unavailable; no automatic retry or deadline extension.

503.description: Backend unavailable; not an explicit device denial.

default.description: Unavailable/protocol error. Includes HTTP200, every other 2xx, redirects, bad requests, endpoint404 and other5xx. Never interpret a JSON body as allow/deny. Bound discarded error bodies to4KiB then close.

post.summary: Authorize one client operation on one topic or filter
post.description: Authorize exact client_id/username/action/topic.204 allows,403 denies only this operation.401 is service access failure, never cached as deny. Other statuses unavailable. No response JSON. See ../http-auth-api.md.

parameters.name: X-Request-ID
parameters.description: Optional tracing only. Service may ignore; response echo not required.

204.description: Allow. No content. Authentication binds the verified username; ACL permits this exact operation. No response Content-Type or ID echo required.

403.description: Deny this exact ACL operation. Do not infer global account revocation. Error body ignored and not logged.

401.description: Broker-to-ACL-service credentials/access fault. Unavailable; never cache as deny.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Applicable HTTP authentication challenge. Broker does not automatically retry or forward device passwords based on it.

429.description: Backend rate limit/overload. Unavailable; no automatic retry or deadline extension.

503.description: Backend unavailable; not an explicit device denial.

default.description: Unavailable/protocol error. Includes HTTP200, every other 2xx, redirects, bad requests, endpoint404 and other5xx. Never interpret a JSON body as allow/deny. Bound discarded error bodies to4KiB then close.

ServiceToken.description: Broker-to-service credential; not MQTT user password.

Username.description: Unique stable device identity; exact case-sensitive UTF8. Trusted for ACL only after successful authentication.

oneOf.description: Only for non-UTF8 passwords. Canonical RFC4648, decoded <=65535 bytes. Never include together with password, including null.

topic.description: Publish: concrete valid MQTT Topic Name. Subscribe: valid MQTT Topic Filter; no receive-time checks. Broker strips shared wrapper only for initial shared subscription. Service must authorize full requested filter range.
